components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The default action — indigo fill, white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 24px; border:none; border-radius:8px; background:#4343D5; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .15s ease, transform .15s ease, background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#2E2BC2; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity:.9; transform:scale(.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #4343D5; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary (Ghost) Button
components.description: Recedes against the white tile — soft hairline border, indigo label.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid #C7C4D7; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:#4343D5; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { opacity:.9; transform:scale(.99); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #4343D5; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: One per screen — the single most valuable action (e.g. upgrade). Burnt-orange fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 24px; border:none; border-radius:8px; background:#944A1C; color:#FFFFFF; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .15s ease, transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:active { opacity:.9; transform:scale(.99); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #944A1C; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Full-pill filter/category tag. Selected = indigo fill + white; unselected = field fill + dark ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:none; border-radius:999px; background:#F1F3F9; color:#161D1F; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:opacity .15s ease; } .ds-chip:active { opacity:.8; } .ds-chip--selected { background:#4343D5; color:#FFFFFF; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #4343D5; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Bento Tile
components.description: The repeated white panel. Borderless; depth from ambient shadow, not rules.

components.css: .ds-tile { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; padding:24px; border-radius:16px; background:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:0px 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; max-width:320px; } .ds-tile__eyebrow { font-size:14px; font-weight:600; color:#464555; } .ds-tile__figure { font-size:28px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.5px; color:#161D1F; } .ds-tile__sub { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#464555; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Filled (not outlined) so it stays visible inside a white tile. 2px border shifts color on focus without reflow.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; max-width:320px; } .ds-field__label { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#464555; } .ds-field__input { min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border:2px solid transparent; border-radius:8px; background:#F1F3F9; color:#161D1F; font-size:16px; font-weight:400; } .ds-field__input::placeholder { color:#464555; } .ds-field__input:focus { outline:none; border-color:#4343D5; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: Icon tile + label + optional detail + direction-aware chevron, on a white tile.
components.css: .ds-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; width:100%; min-height:56px; padding:16px; border:none; border-radius:16px; background:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:0px 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; text-align:left; } .ds-row:active { opacity:.9; } .ds-row__icon { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:12px; background:#E1E0FF; flex:none; } .ds-row__mid { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; flex:1; } .ds-row__label { font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:#161D1F; } .ds-row__sub { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#464555; } .ds-row__detail { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#464555; }

components.name: Budget Progress Ring
components.description: Signature category meter. Rounded stroke caps; track indigo-muted, fill normal→full→over (indigo→orange→danger).

components.name: Bottom Tab Item
components.description: Active tab is an indigo pill (icon + caption in white); inactive is muted. Bar floats on the raised shadow.
components.css: .ds-tabbar { display:flex; gap:8px; padding:8px; border-radius:24px 24px 0 0; background:#FFFFFF; box-shadow:0px 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; max-width:280px; } .ds-tab { display:flex; flex:1; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:2px; min-height:52px; padding:4px; border:none; border-radius:16px; background:transparent; color:#464555; font-size:11px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tab span { color:#464555; } .ds-tab--active { background:#4343D5; } .ds-tab--active span { color:#FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview: The system behaves like a quietly capable concierge for a household's money: it carries real expertise — multiple currencies, multiple members, multiple countries — and returns it as something calm and handled. Competence leads; warmth follows. An indigo trust primary does the confident, reliable work of a well-run institution, while a burnt-orange growth accent, used sparingly, keeps the product human rather than clinical. Everything sits on a cool paper canvas so the interface reads as bright, unhurried, and never anxious about money. Structurally the app is a field of floating white bento tiles — borderless, separated through tone and a soft ambient shadow, never through rules or boxes. The tone is calm, precise, and reassuring; the design's confidence comes from restraint.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo-led trust on a cool blue-white canvas; warmth from a single restrained accent.
Borderless white bento tiles floating on soft ambient shadow.
Low density, generous hierarchy, sentence-case voice — no all-caps, no hairline grids.
Global-first: every layout is direction-aware (LTR/RTL) and script-aware (Latin/Arabic).
Data has its own reserved color (sky), kept clear of interactive elements.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Burnt-Orange Growth marks at most one action per screen. If two things are orange, neither is special — demote one to indigo or ghost.

rules.name: The Sky-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Sky Signal belongs to information and chart series, never to buttons, chips, or links. Data and action never share a color.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: No all-caps. The eyebrow is a sentence-case section label, not an uppercase kicker — the entire system is sentence case.

rules.name: The Shadow-Not-Rules Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from white-on-canvas contrast plus ambient shadow. Reach for a border only when tone and shadow can't carry it — and then it's the soft Hairline, never a crisp box.

rules.name: The Width-Not-OS Rule
rules.body: Layout follows viewport width (1024px breakpoint), never Platform.OS. A phone browser gets the mobile layout; a tablet in landscape gets the wide one.

dos: Do float borderless white tiles on the cool-paper canvas; let the Tile shadow and tone do the separating.
Do keep Burnt-Orange Growth to one action per screen; make indigo the workhorse.
Do reserve Sky Signal for information and data series only.
Do write labels in sentence case, including eyebrows.
Do drive layout from viewport width (1024px breakpoint), and keep every layout direction-aware (LTR/RTL) and script-aware (Plus Jakarta Sans / Readex Pro).
Do use rounded strokes and the shared normal→full→over color semantic for every meter.
donts: Don't build hairline-boxed, spreadsheet-dense finance UI. No ruled grids, no bordered cards — separation is tone + ambient shadow.
Don't ship a dark neon 'trading app' aesthetic. This system is light, cool, calm, and warm.
Don't color an interactive control with Sky Signal, or let two elements wear the accent.
Don't add a third+ shadow depth or a crisp structural shadow ladder — two ambient tokens only.
